name: The Chase Table (d6)
description:
The row names two traits that work this round, for everyone in the chase.

Rulebook, Chapter 6: The Chase Table.

In Foundry the chase tracker rolls the ground each round (Roll the ground when chases are run by hand).

results.description:
The crowded square. Lose yourself in the crowd, or bluff your way through.

Traits that work: Sly, Charm

Back alleys. Duck, dodge, double back.

Traits that work: Nimble, Sly

The market stalls. Overturn a cart, vault a stall.

Traits that work: Brawn, Nimble

Over the rooftops. Climb, jump, find a way down.

Traits that work: Nimble, Wits

The festival parade. Join in: you’re in costume, after all.

Traits that work: Charm, Sly

A dead end. Break through, or think fast.

Traits that work: Brawn, Wits
